project.name: Monolith Helidon Adapter
project.description: OPTIONAL adapter that bridges Monolith's reactive change feed to Helidon SE WebSockets. Provides a ready-made WsListener that manages the live-query subscribe/push lifecycle against a ReactiveHub. Monolith's core does not depend on this, applications that use a different web framework (or none) can ignore it and wire the ReactiveHub themselves.
